title: North Korea opens a housing district for families of its soldiers killed in Russia-Ukraine war
summary: North Korea said Monday it completed a new housing district in Pyongyang for families of North Korean soldiers killed while fighting alongside Russian forces in Ukraine.
contentText:
North Korea said Monday it completed a new housing district in Pyongyang for families of North Korean soldiers killed while fighting alongside Russian forces in Ukraine.

(Image credit: Korean Central News Agency/Korea News Service)
